contract.forward: forall n : Int, Even n -> n % 2 = 0
contract.backward: forall n : Int, n % 2 = 0 -> Even n
contract.result: forall n : Int, Even n iff n % 2 = 0

proof_route: lambda over n returning Iff.intro of the two injected directions; no simp, private theorem, decision instance, or official Int.even_iff use
next_on_accept: Qualify the forward direction from even witnesses and clean modulo multiplication, then the backward direction from explicit quotient witnesses.
limitations: The residual is support-only and cannot replace Int.even_iff until both arithmetic directions are cleanly specialized.
